title: Session Summaries (part 3)
content:
Session 21 - “Seven Charges!” 7/4/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

Before session 22, level up to Level 6!

  • Travel on Little Oak. Gaining a pleasant ride on the back of the massive treant named Little Oak, the Party traveled for over six days through the forests of Thither toward the mysterious Wayward Pool, a lake where a unicorn was said to live. 

  • Mini-games. Along the way, the Getaway Gang kids played mini-games with the Party, including Hide & Seek, Acorn Slinging, and Liars Dice. Winners got some fancy prizes, magical items that Little Oak had stashed in his branches.

  • Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! Shots! 

  • Addiction & Madness. Daterra's addiction and Kronk's madness ended.

  • Dask Departs. No longer "Maglubiyet's Shepherd", Dask Mudmaw lost his Paladin abilities, and his Yeth Hounds and birds turned hostile toward everyone. Dask jumped on a hound, stabbing at it as it bounded away with him still on its back before Sig could stop it. Perry and Jib killed another hound, and the birds were defeated and fled. 

  • Dask’s Equipment. Dask only had time to grab his weapons and holy symbol, so Sig held onto the rest of his stuff.

  • Kronk abilities. In another dream-training with Shuushar, Kronk began unlocking strange new abilities. Though when he tried to use them, they kept failing, probably requiring practice.

  • Perry ability. Perry also began unlocking new abilities, learning how to give Names to items and use his marbles to power them. He named his scythe “Bondbreaker” and noticed something strange begin to change with it.

  • Marble memory of Puck. And later when Perry peered into a marble, he saw a memory vision within it. He saw a satyr who he remembered from a while back, someone who had been at the scene when Perry witnessed something he wasn't supposed to and then "lost his marbles". The satyr, who had gone by the name "Puck", had similar features to Daterra. And when Daterra and Jibjib joined in on looking into the memory, they realized this was Daterra's father, whom she'd never met!

  • Unicorn disguises. When they finally reached the Wayward Pool, everyone had to find a way across the water. The island's magic prevented all flight, and only unicorns were able to cross. Will and the kids came prepared with a plan however, using homemade unicorn costumes to trick the wards. Daterra used Wild Shape and then made a horn with Mold Earth to disguise herself. The kids had to use two full costumes to cover all of Kronk's beefy orcness. Sig transformed himself into a pretty little pony. And Perry, Jib, and Kle's antlers all wore costumes. 

  • All other kids and pets remained on Little Oak a good distance away just off-map for safety. Agdon and Shuushar remained on the shoreline but didn't cross or disguise themselves. 

  • Brazier of coals. We ended just after stepping foot on the island, looking at a big iron brazier filled with coals and starting to learn about the magical environment effects in the area.

  • Most importantly… Jibjib used 2 of his 7 charges on his Wand of Enemy Detection! So he has 5 charges left!

Current Objectives: 

  • Find your Stolen Things.

  • Find out who framed you for stealing things from Hourglass Coven hag sisters.

  • Find the missing unicorn horn to unfreeze Zybilna in her palace.

  • End the Hags’ tyranny over Prismeer.

  • Return Bavlorna's Big Book of Bad Blood, and all her other stuff from her Cottage?

  • Rescue kids from Loomlurch: Nira Nestfoot’s daughter Naal, Nib Blackfyre’s niece and nephew Wendel and Wren, Dask’s adoptive daughter Yevelda, and others.

  • Stop the demons pouring into the Underdark from the Abyss.

  • Solve the Puzzle Box.

  • Bring Nib furnishings for his home.

  • Deal with individual character quests and plotlines.


Mysteries & Leads: 

  • Rifts between Underdark, Feywild, and Abyss. “Faerzress” and “fairy circles” amplified.

  • Jibjib learned of conspiracies from his Patron. Also warned to return to Underdark asap.

  • Demons are pouring into the Underdark through portals for some reason.

  • Bav’s Book seems to have a lot of interesting names in it.

  • Zybilna and/or her Palace staff members have powerful magic items, make magic circles, and know about defeating/trapping demons.

  • “Rad”, a strange elf that looked identical to others met in backstories, came from a Rift and gave Perry a puzzle box. The elf disintegrated into another Rift, rambling strange phrases as he went. Another similar elf named Smite helped fight the Shepherd. 



Session 20 - “Little Oak” 5/23/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

  • Names. An interesting reoccurring theme of 'names' kept coming up this session, the importance of knowing someone's true name in the Feywild becoming more apparent.

  • Kronk’s Madness. We started this session with a scene where Kronk saw strange visions from the perspective of Shaiir Vandree, the second-in-command drow from Velkynvelve. Kronk's madness from last session gave him torturous guilt for killing Shaiir, throwing the elf from Velkynvelve to be eaten alive by giant spiders. Kronk saw Shaiir's soul being dragged through the afterlife, the Abyssal realm called the Demonweb Pits. The drow's ghostly form then burst from Kronk's chest, and the two wrestled and conversed briefly. Kronk learned that Priestess Ilvara and her remaining drow were still hunting the Party!

  • Shepherd Calmed. Combat against The Shepherd (Dask Mudmaw) was de-escalated, and the Party restrained him to prevent him from fleeing. With the goblin, hounds, and birds finally subdued, the Party convinced Dask they could be allies against Skabatha and the hags, and work together to rescue Yevelda and the other kids from Loomlurch.

  • The Sword. Shepherd's sword, 'Calm', had to be taken out of Jibjib's chest. A skill challenge involved Sig's medicine knowledge, Daterra's sleight of hand, and Kronk's strength to pull the sword out safely.

  • Travel to Little Oak. The Party decided to press onward to Little Oak. Shepherd came along as an ally, at least for now. He still seemed lost and purposeless, but slowly trust was building.

  • Treant Footprints. The Party tracked giant uprooted craters – footprints! Later they learned the treant digs up treasure as he walks across the land.

  • Little Oak and the Getaway Gang. They encountered Little Oak, a massive treant with a cluster of rickety treehouses, ladders, and swings built atop its branches. Living on him were four kids called the Getaway Gang: tough-talking human leader Will of the Feywild, dwarf boy Kinruk, elf girl Vellora "Vell" Candleye, and orc girl Zennor "Zen".

  • Bav’s Bloodhounds. The Party shouted up at the children on the treant's back. The leery kids didn't trust them, recognizing them as "Bav's Bloodhounds", rumored to be the "gang" working for Bavlorna and with Agdon Longscarf and his harengon brigands. It took some convincing that these weren't exactly true rumors.

  • One True Tree. The kids invited the Party up to play a game called "One True Tree" where Little Oak used a staff he'd found to cast Zone of Truth.  Everyone told their true names. Jibjib the Enlightened, Big Daddy Kronk or whatever Jeffrey said idfk, etc. They learned each other's intentions, and much was revealed about the other orphans taken in by Skabatha at Loomlurch. They learned about Yevelda, the goblin girl Shepherd was determined to find, which solidified his trust in everyone, knowing they were truthful in saying Yev was still alive and Maglubiyet had lied. They learned of Naal, Nira Nestfoot's daughter, and her misty step power. They told Will how Naal's mom had died. They learned each kid seemed to have an uncanny power from living in the Feywild so long. And they learned how Loomlurch is actually the fallen tree Agdon used to hang from.

  • Pets and Planning. Will of the Feywild, the Getaway Gang's leader, had a pet Displacer Beast kitten named Star, who played with Banksy, and was only friendly with Daterra even though half the Party tried their hand at befriending it. Once trust was built, Will and Sig shared their pet spiders, and Sig helped name Will's spider "Lavender". Will then wanted to plot how to rescue kids from Loomlurch, telling the Party things he knew about Skab's home.

  • The Unicorn. Will also told of a possible destination of interest for the Party, a place called the Wayward Pool, where a unicorn named Lamorna lived.

  • Zen the orc girl. Zennor acted tough, always barely suppressing her rage ability, but Kronk had a heart-to-heart with her, and Daterra gave her a druid-crafted flower for her hair. The girl was extremely shy and ran from them both, but clearly bonds were being built.

  • Mini-Game Activities. The Party tried out several mini-game activities, including mushroom foraging, fishing, and Jibjib's mask-making.

  • Lornling. Another Lornling was sent to Daterra, who gave more trinkets as payment to Bav.

  • Agdon Pickpockets Sig. Agdon was caught nonchalantly pickpocketing Sig, but said he was only practicing and making a point about overhearing something, winking at Sig as if knowing something.

  • Puzzle Progress. More progress was made on the Puzzle Box. A new symbol had appeared, names were figured out to be a part of it, and the marbles floated above the box as if waiting for something.

  • Free Ride. The Party continued to ride Little Oak the treant like a bus across the forest of Thither, on their way to their next destination...

Session 19 - “The Shepherd” 5/2/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

  • The Shepherd’s true form. As Daterra and Bav saw through the fox illusion, the Shepherd's true form was revealed -- a heavily armored goblin dual-wielding a sword and glaive.

  • Hesitation and tension. At first the Party was unsure if they should attack the Shepherd or not. He kept backing away defensively toward the tree-line where his Yeth Hounds waited in darkness for the sun to go down.

  • Shepherd’s motives. Daterra tried to restrain Shepherd with Entangle. And Jibjib used Detect Thoughts, learning Shepherd seemed intent on fighting Jibjib, not concerned at all with any of the others. He mentioned wanting to “save” goblins who had strayed from his god.

  • Sundown. As the sun slowly descended, tension kept building while the Party tried to talk Shepherd down from fighting. But in darkness finally, the Hounds were unleashed from the trees, and full-on combat broke out.

  • Aid from allies. Mr. Six granted a Bless spell to Sig and a few others. And Bav's eye also granted aid, shooting spells from Daterra.

  • Combat. The Shepherd was a powerful foe, a paladin of Maglubiyet the goblin god, with spells and items perfect for fighting spellcasters and hunting goblins. He rode around on a Yeth Hound, his birds protecting and distracting. He used the Fear spell, and his Hounds used their fear-inducing howls, causing disruption throughout the Party. The Party rallied to defend Jibjib, with Kronk charging in between Jib and Shepherd, Daterra and Sig using powerful spells like Moonbeam and Spirit Guardians, and Perry and Agdon riding Kle into battle.

  • Jibjib KO’d. But Shepherd succeeded in his mission, downing Jibjib. Shepherd stabbed his sword 'Calm' down into Jib's chest to finish him off and send his soul to his master.

  • Madness Lightning. But as the sword impaled Jibjib's chest, a thunderous explosion of chaos erupted, blasting everyone back, purplish lightning and madness tearing the battlefield apart!Crackling bursts of electricity sprang up from the ground as the fight against Shepherd and his Hounds and birds continued. These lighting areas caused Madness in anyone they touched, and Agdon, Kronk, and Shepherd himself were all greatly affected.

  • Smite. Out of the Rift-like cracks in the earth came tumbling yet another elven 'traveler', this one named Smite. He came ready to fight and defend the Party, raising his wondrous elven sword and charging at Shepherd.

  • The Astral Sea. As Jibjib fell into the Astral Sea in a tug of war between 3 strange entities vying for his soul, Kronk and Shuushar were able to see this otherworldly scene, and Sig was able to jump through a Rift to follow!

  • Choosing a Patron. With Sig along for the ride to give advice, Jibjib found himself part of a series of visions. The 3 entities made arguments and pleas, each wanting Jibjib to choose them as his Patron.

  • Maglubiyet. The Battle Lord, god of goblins, was the first. Shepherd was a paladin for this god, but Jibjib said nah!

  • Mr. Six. Jib and Sig learned that the mysterious Mr. Six that had recently replaced Sig's cleric deity was in fact the same entity pretending to be Jibjib's Patron and speaking to him through his stuffed frog this whole time! They never learned the true name of Mr. Six, but Sig argued heavily for Jib to choose him since he had proven very helpful to them thus far.

  • Dagon. The 3rd entity was revealed to be Jibjib's original "Great Old One" warlock Patron, who was recently being replaced by Mr. Six. Wise old Sig knew this one's true name: Dagon, an ancient eldritch horror!

  • Jibjib’s Choice. In the end, despite Sig's advice to choose Mr. Six, Jibjib chose to keep Dagon as his Patron. With the others pushed aside, and Dagon given enough power over the little goblin's soul, Jibjib and Sig came tumbling back to the Material plane, alive and safe!

  • Dask Mudmaw. Shepherd was racked with Madness from the lightning effects, forced to hug onto one of his Hounds helplessly. Back from the Astral Sea, Jibjib immediately dashed forward and shouted "Dask Mudmaw!", Shepherd's true name! Seizing Shepherd's attention, Jibjib revealed to him the truths he learned from Dagon. Dask/Shepherd had dedicated his life to Maglubiyet based on lies and manipulation.

  • Puzzle Box. Meanwhile, with mere seconds left before the strange elf named Smite would dematerialize into a Rift, Perry and Daterra asked him if he knew about the Puzzle Box. Smite looked at them curiously, saying "I haven't made it yet", before slipping away…

Session 18 - “Nib’s Cave” 3/21/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

  • Nib the Miser. The Party met Nib, an old blindfolded man who spun gold into magic items. Endless piles and waterfalls of gold coins filled the cave, and the Party recognized them as the coins that had cursed one of the harengons back at Brigands' Tollway.

  • Kelek's Knight Lights. Nib welcomed the Party in, and they discussed the Knight Light creatures that were stationed outside the cave. Nib suspected that an elf named Kelek was behind the ambush. Kelek, ex-husband of Nira Nestfoot, was originally an artist from the Summer/Seelie Court who had been twisted into a servant of the Queen of the Gloaming/Unseelie Court. The creatures that attacked the Party were probably creations of Kelek. Nib warned that the Unseelie were seeking travelers of the same description as the Party, as well as seeking the missing unicorn horn.

  • The Curse. Nib told his story of being an evil landlord back in the Material plane city of Waterdeep. He came to the Feywild and asked Granny Skabatha Nightshade to help him make amends for his past. She cursed him, bound him to this cave and made him turn all his wealth into useful items. And he was haunted by ghosts of those he had wronged in the past. Unable to look at them, he blindfolded himself, and developed the Blindsight ability.

  • Items for Skab. Nib said the Hags didn't trust him because he would help everyone that came to his cave. Skabatha would come by periodically to have him make her items, though he didn't really remember what he made.

  • Morality. The Party tried to convince Nib he shouldn't just help everyone that comes by, like evil hags. But he clearly had talked with Skab a lot and was swayed by her, knowing she wasn't exactly good but had done good things for him.

  • Missing Relatives. Nib asked the Party to look for his family, and they convinced him to tell his full name, Nib Blackfyre. If they could find his sister Marcyn and her son and daughter (he can't remember their names), it would prove that Nib was wrong about Skab and how she ends up with "adopted" children.

  • Overnight. The Party rested while Nib made them amazing items out of gold. Kronk dreamed with Shuushar, learning like a padawan, seeing a memory where Shuushar was shipwrecked on an island in the Darklake and watched a rat and snail in a series of 'tortoise and hare' scenarios.

  • Furnishings. Before they left, Nib requested they bring him furnishings to make his cave nicer. Daterra put up some horrific inky portrait paintings of darklings from the balloon shop at Downfall. Nib was ecstatic, imagining them as beautiful landscapes.

  • Return Anytime. Clapperclaw stayed at Nib's, but said to come back if they ever needed to go back to Hither. Nib said they were welcome back to his cave anytime.

  • Foraging. Outside the cave, the Party foraged, and Perry had a fun experience with a raybark mushroom.

  • Campestris. Sig and Daterra went foraging on their own and found a 'fairy circle', a portal from the Feywild to the Material, which seemed amplified by all the Rift stuff happening lately. The mushrooms of the circle were actually campestris, hilarious little mushroom creatures. They were dumb and only able to talk in mimicry, so Daterra cast Speak with Plants, and Sig offered them snake jerky. The campestris told how Skab comes to Nib's sometimes. They also explained how to use the fairy circle. Then they hummed a tune and gave Sig and Daterra charms with their song.

  • Toad-em Pole. Jibjib's stuffed frog started animating and speaking. Jib hated the voice, so he yelled at the frog until it changed to a deep smooth voice instead. When seeing a fat toad on a branch, the patron said Jibjib could exert his influence over it. Jibjib charmed the toad and gained the first of possibly many little followers. He named it 'Toadst' and stacked it along with the stuffed frog on his head, a toad-em pole.

  • Puzzle Box. Perry had now collected 8 marbles, which allowed them to make much more progress with the puzzle box. The marbles moved around depending on which symbol track they were on. They figured out the symbols on the sides corresponded with certain characters in the adventure.

  • Tree Trunk Bridge. As they travelled, they had to cross a massive bridge-like tree trunk along the path. Jibjib used rope on a crossbow bolt, and they balanced across.

  • Aggressive Trees. The Party encountered colossal trees that were angry and violent from hag corruption. The trees swayed and tilted, slamming down to crush anything that got close. The Party struggled to think of a plan, knowing one false step could mean instant death. They skipped stones and shot at the trees to test their reactions, making them crash down like falling skyscrapers that shook the earth. Sig snuck invisibly by the first tree, but the second detected him and tensed up, waiting to crush Sig if he stepped forward. Perry talked with a local badger to ask how to get across, but he was simply told not to go that way. In the end, it was all too risky, so the Party backed out in hopes of finding a long way around this encounter.

  • The Fox and the Hounds. As they traveled from forest to open hills, they noticed a creature approaching, encircled by a flock of birds and strange howling beasts. They realized how weird it was to see ravens, crows, and hawks all together. And they recognized the howls as yeth hounds, fey creatures with some intelligence, usually dangerous servants of powerful fey. Daterra sent JJ ahead with Jibjib in his eyes, and tension built between all the birds, the yeth hounds darting unseen in the shadows of nearby woods. The creature leading the flock was an anthropomorphic fox. They let the fox approach, and Jibjib did most of the talking. The fox said he was called the Shepherd, and asked if they'd seen any goblins around, followers of the goblin god Maglubiyet. Jib admitted he was a goblin and not a follower of the god. The fox was hard to read, and tension rose as they stared each other down, Jib's patron saying something was wrong and to keep his guard up. The Shepherd bid them safe travels and turned to walk away. Bav began watching through Daterra's eye, the eye darting around, panicked or confused about who this Shepherd was. Daterra and Bav used Truesight to see that the fox form was an illusion! Daterra called out, "He's a goblin!" The Shepherd turned around and looked back at them, anger in his eyes. Roll initiative!

Session 17 - “Thither” 2/28/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Jibjib

  • The Party rested in Bav's guest bedroom. In the middle of the night, "Rad" the strange elf departed, ripping apart and disintegrating into his own personal Rift in the planes. As he left, he was heard rambling seemingly nonsensical phrases about numbers and dates.

  • Everyone awoke feeling especially reinvigorated, surging with newfound powers (from leveling up, but it's fun to say all this Fey/Rift stuff is part of the explanation).

  • Perry summoned a new friend. Klé the elk, a fey steed, came crashing through the window, and they wrecked the walls on the way out of Bav's house, Agdon riding backwards on the elk with Sir Perry.

  • The Party took a bullywug boat across the Murky Lake at Downfall, avoiding creepy merfolk lurking below the surface.

  • They talked to Clapperclaw the scarecrow kid again. After several failed rolls, it became canon that the kid is just always terrified of both Kronk and Jibjib. But Daterra returned his stag-skull head, and he happily agreed to guide them to Thither in search of the rest of their Missing Things and other loose threads in their adventure.

  • Before leaving Downfall, they spotted the decapitated head of King Gullop XIX, the bullywug king they had encountered before. He has since been assassinated and replaced as monarch, becoming yet another talking head on a spike along Clapperclaw's bridge at the edge of town.

  • Jibjib also checked in with his stoney friend the Galeb Duhr, a rock elemental creature who lies in the water like a stepping stone.

  • Clapperclaw led the Party through the mists at the edge of Hither, and swamp began turning to forest. They stepped into a new colorful yet gloomy landscape, Thither.

  • They encountered a fork in the road. Three paths, each very different. One had colorful flowers and a path that changed based on their moods. Here Perry found one of his marbles!

  • Another path had white flowers that were actually adorable yet dangerous snakes.

  • The third path had floating lanterns filled with fey fireflies. This was the path they chose, which happened to be quite harmless.

  • Clapperclaw led them to the cave home of his friend Nib the Miser. But in the forest just outside the cave, thousands of floating candles filled the air. Clapperclaw didn't remember these being here before.

  • Daterra used her new familiar, JJ the raven, to scout ahead. Jibjib used his newfound ability Gaze of Two Minds to see through JJ's eyes.

  • The raven spotted a wanted poster on a tree, which had a drawing of a kid named Will of the Feywild, and a reward for turning him in to "Granny Nightshade", aka Skabatha.

  • JJ also spotted strange armor constructs hiding among the floating candles and foliage outside the cave.

  • The Party tried to stealth past the constructs, but they were spotted and ambushed. The creatures were called Knight Lights, durable suits of armor with candelabras for heads and armor that adapted to take on resistance to the last damage type dealt to it.

  • The adaptive armor combat puzzle proved a tough challenge. The Party fought the 6 Knight Lights and their Boss, the scythe-wielding Knight Light Revenant.

  • After defeating the armors, the Party looted the scythe and the ruined chunks of metal armor, which looked expensive and worth selling.

  • Finally they entered Nib's Cave. Inside they saw a waterfall of gold coins, and piles upon piles of golden treasure everywhere! The old man named Nib the Miser sat blindfolded and working away at his spinning wheel of gold. He turned and smiled, welcoming them in...

Session 16 - “Back to Bavlorna” 2/8/25

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Kronk, Azaelith

Before session 17, level up to Level 5!

  • After falling out of a rift from the Underdark, the Party found themselves on the rooftops of Bav's Cottage and the Inn at the End of the Road. Bav had taken over the Inn, parking it like an extension to her half-demolished house.

  • They entered the Inn. Inside they found Morgort the female bullywug knight, Sir Talavar the fairy dragon, and Madam Harabax the innkeeper. Harabax was thought dead, killed by Zargash the evil satyr, but here she was, sitting alive behind the bar! All three were silent, barely reacting to the Party.

  • Harabax motioned to follow her and shuffled to the back. Perry and Kronk followed. (Jeffrey called it, this was just like Bathilda Bagshot in Harry Potter)

  • Perry took one step down toward the basement to follow Harabax, and just as he realized it was trap, the door slammed behind him, cutting him off from Kronk and the others.

  • The Party rested at the Inn at the End of the Road.

  • They ate magical foods and drinks, served by animated dishes and utensils. 

  • Cody’s character was introduced, Perry the harengon paladin, a quirky knightly folk hero and local of this region of the feywild. He was a guest at the Inn, seen expertly playing piano by the bar. Perry kept referring to Daterra as his squire, and proved to be a loyal and capable new addition to the team, if not a bit loud and unpredictable. 

  • Some players gambled with Jimjar and some other guests at the Inn, including a dragonborn named Kriv, a kenku named Popper, and a pixie named Chips. They played a game called Wild Jack, and Daterra won the pot, which included Jimjar’s name, a year of Popper’s lifespan, the low tones of Kriv’s laugh, and a bright hue from Chip’s wings.

  • The Party talked to the Innkeeper, Madam Styria Harabax, a druid who knits things with her ever-growing hair. She gave them lots of information in return for helping her with problems around the Inn.

  • Madam Harabax told them: 

    • They are in the feywild realm of Prismeer, which until recently had been ruled by Archfey Zybilna.

    • There are rumors that Zybilna is trapped in her Palace and has lost control of Prismeer.

    • The land is now corrupted and broken into 3 regions called Hither, Thither, and Yon. The Party is currently in the swampland Hither. Mists prevent anyone from traveling between the 3 regions. 

    • Prismeer has recently been ruled by the Hourglass Coven, a trio of feared elderly sisters.

    • Hither is ruled by Bulging-eye Bav aka Slack-jawed Lorna. 

    • Harabax wants any info that might help reinstate Zybilna, saying everything was better when she ruled. Zybilna is described as a fairy godmother type character who ruled firmly but fairly.

  • The Party helped Harabax rid the Inn of a stubborn guest upstairs that refused to leave. Eryne the Harpy was an annoying teenager hysterically drinking her broken-hearted sorrows away and running up a huge tab at the Inn. The Party played Never Have I Ever with her, which resulted in Kronk getting too drunk and Jibjib angering the Harpy. Eryne attacked along with her flowerpot Mimic named Seeder (like cedar chest). Kronk led them to a peaceful resolution, calming Eryne with a bear hug. They convinced the harpy to leave the Inn, and she may prove to be an ally one day.

  • The Party helped Harabax calm Oscar the Otyugh in the basement. The monstrous garbage-disposing Oscar was rampaging because of his telepathic connection to the plane-shifting portal problems lately as well as the demon problems in the Underdark, his childhood home. Several scars were earned from KO’s from Oscars grappling tentacles. 

  • During the night, a Satyr entered the Inn and harrassed Madam Harabax. The Party confronted him and his Mushroom-Armor bodyguard. They learned he was sent on behalf of the Queen of the Gloaming Court, an Archfey of another feywild realm outside Prismeer, who has an alliance with the Hourglass Coven. The Satyr was sent around the region to threaten people for information on a missing Unicorn Horn. The Party intimidated the Satyr, and he left the Inn. 

  • Madam Harabax thanked the Party for saving her and for all the help around the Inn. Not only did she clear their tab, but she became indebted to them, welcoming them to find the Inn whenever they need it in the future, and telling them everything she knew that could help in their quests:

    • Downfall is the swamp town where Slack-jawed Lorna lives. Every problem in Hither seems to lead to encountering her there, but no one knows how to find the town.

    • Slanty Tower, where the Party saw a hot air balloon crashing earlier, was an outpost of Zybilna’s Palace, and may hold answers.

    • Telemy Hill is hard to get to, but they can find a goblin named Jingle Jangle there who may prove helpful.

    • Brigands' Tollway is the headquarters of the harengon gang leader Agdon Longscarf, who could have answers if defeated.

  • Secrets of the Inn:

    • The Inn at the End of the Road is a ferry for those in Prismeer who are at the end of their road, meaning dead.

    • The Inn travels the land picking up dead bodies, lost and troubled souls, and regular guests like the Party.

    • Bodies provide feet for the underside of the Inn, hearts for ‘hearty stew’, etc. 

    • Oscar recycles bodies in the basement.

    • Some souls are troubled and stay at the Inn longer than others, enjoying the amenities and gambling.

    • Some living guests choose to stay at the Inn forever as a sort of afterlife. Their bodies pass on, and their souls need new vessels, so Madam Harabax uses her strange form of druidic magic to knit them Cat-bodies from her hair. These cats live here happily, only keeping vague memories of their past lives, usually expressed in their preferences for decorating the Inn with things from their former cultures, like Christmas trees.

    • Living guests who don’t want to stay forever can simply rest at the Inn, travel on it like a train, and get off at one of the stops.

  • Shuushar and Prince Derendil both seem to love it here at the Inn, with Shuushar starting to resemble a catfish more and more. 

  • Jimjar gambled away his name and now calls himself Frildric Deadbolt. He doesn’t want to leave the Inn until he wins big in gambling.


Current Objectives: 

  • Find Stolen Things.

  • Break Sig’s curse. The act of giving the gems is the key.

  • Protect Madam Harabax’s Inn from the Satyr and his Mushroom bodyguard.

  • Investigate feywild locations. All Hither problems lead to Bulging-Eye Bav at Downfall.

  • Jibjib learned of conspiracies from his Patron.

  • Strange pulsing magic around the cave walls. More in the stones of the bridge at the portal when first entering Feywild.

  • Archfey Zybilna trapped in her Palace, Hourglass Coven ruling in her stead, Prismeer corrupted and divided by mists.

Session 1 - “Dreams & Drow” 11/17/23

Played this session: Azaelith Draconis the kobold rogue, Jibjib the goblin warlock, Kronk the orc fighter, Sigfried Thistlewhistle the deep gnome cleric, Daterra the satyr druid.


We played Session 1 out of chronological order, starting the campaign with the words “Roll initiative”. Then players had narrative flashbacks and visions in a series of strange dreams.


This summary is in chronological order of events to make things easier…


  • In the beginning, Azaelith, Kronk, and Daterra happened to be around the same place, at the Moonwyvern Inn. Jibjib started at his Underdark swampy goblin town home. Sig started at his Underdark deep gnome home city of Blingdenstone.

  • Everyone saw a dream vision of multiple voices talking about using illusions and targeting anyone of potential.

  • Each player encountered pixies. Some pixies acquired names from Jibjib, Kronk, and Sig. A spider bit Azaelith while a pixie named Spiderlily freaked him out. A half-eaten apple was taken from Daterra by a pixie named Sick-amore.

  • Party saw a dream vision of someone walking in a garden eating a stolen apple and purposefully dropping Daterra’s half-eaten apple to be found in its place.

  • In a second vision, someone impersonating Jibjib turned in a wanted poster and a kid to a tin soldier at a house made from a fallen tree. Jibjib’s name was given, and a knife with some blood on it was intentionally dropped to be found there.

  • In a third vision, someone bragged about freeing a “Sir Talavar” from a “Bavlorna Blightstraw”. They continued to say her name and make fun of her, then seemed to be watched by someone while dropping the names of Jibjib, Kronk, and Sig very deliberately.

  • Party then saw a follow-up dream vision of 3 hunched sisters talking to each other. They complained about being attacked and burgled a lot lately, and they decided to send thieves out to deal with the people that have been wronging them.

  • Party saw a recent memory, the night after encountering pixies. Thieves came in the night, stealing important things from each player. 

  • Each player’s character felt compelled to follow the thieves, coming upon strange caves made of a mix of plant life and crystal, which became almost like a house of mirrors made of portals, with pulsing magic on the walls. Everyone was trapped, seemingly sent back and forth between planes a few times. They collided with each other, all coming together in the same place.

  • Party had the misfortune of ending up at an Underdark entrance tunnel, surrounded by a Drow raiding party. They were quickly ambushed and captured by the drow and sent to an Underdark prison.

  • Party awakened with foggy memories, immediately entering combat against Ront and his orc goons.

  • Drow guards allowed the combat to happen, hoping to see how strong people were and root out any spellcasters.

  • During combat, Kronk was grappled and stabbed badly, Jibjib had some interactions with the guards and was stabbed and knocked out, Azaelith threw a bedsheet, Sig sneaked and healed, and Daterra entangled Ront. Kronk basically defeated Ront, but all fighters were knocked out by drow darts, with Daterra staying the most resilient to the very end.

  • The next day, the party awakened in prison again. Daterra had drawn attention from guards for being capable and approaching the guards in combat. Jibjib also drew attention, constantly annoying the guards. All 3 casters drew attention and were restrained with immovable iron gauntlets and “heavy armor” on their chests which prevented casting. The guards noticed how tough Kronk was, but this didn’t seem to draw too much attention to him. Azaelith went the least noticed by far.

  • Player characters talked with each other during this time in the cell, some telling a lot about their backgrounds and stolen things, some sharing very little. 

  • Players also interacted with the NPC prisoners:

    • Tueue the spider was always on Sig’s shoulder.

    • Ront the orc was shamed for losing to Kronk but still held onto his unnatural anger.

    • The 2 other orcs became submissive to Kronk.

    • Sarith the drow hadn’t talked much so far. Azaelith angered him.

    • Stool the myconid was scared, but Jibjib befriended him and named him Shrump.

    • Derendil the quaggoth seemed too uppity to Jibjib but hadn’t talked much yet.

    • Topsy and Turvy the deep gnomes seemed secretive but friendly to Sig.

    • Shuushar the kuo-toa seemed talkative and nice but judgy and weird to Daterra.

    • Buppido the derro thought himself a god.

    • Eldeth the dwarf seemed normal and good, didn’t know much. But she wanted alliances, especially with Daterra, and somewhat with Jibjib.

    • Jimjar the deep gnome befriended Azaelith and told him a lot:

      • Party has been in prison 10 days, waiting to be transported to Menzo. Orcs came just before Party, then others, last was Eldeth arriving just after Party got knocked out in combat.

      • 19 Drow here. 1 drow has fallen out of favor. Drow seem to only speak Elven and Undercommon.

      • Antimagic on at least this cell. Gate has a pickable lock but the bars seem very strong.

  • Jibjib got conspiracy dream info: 

    • There’s an intelligent presence in the dream visions, watching them. It seems to be reaching out broadly, not necessarily to just the Party, trying to help guide people through dream visions to help them. It gives Jibjib good emotions. It also reveals that there is a web of overlapping confusing things happening at once, multiple big powerful players all working their own plots against each other, full of betrayal and conflict and alliances between them.

  • Other mysteries lately: 

    • Strange pulsing magic around the cave walls. 

    • Horrific hallucinations happened during combat.
